content:
Jordan L: Ivy wants a Private POC with BYOK + HSM proof. Need step-by-step onboarding + what we absolutely need from them within 48h.

Amy S: Two options: (1) Customer BYOK (AWS KMS or HSM-wrapped) or (2) Redwood-managed temporary key (fast, needs addendum).

Natasha V: For BYOK we require: KMS key ARN with a key policy granting our service principal, VPC id + subnets, CA-signed agent cert (PEM), and if HSM -> wrapped key blob + attestation doc. POC rotation acceptable at 30d; note prod expects 7d.

Jordan L: Please give copy-paste commands and the minimal JSON they should send.

Natasha V: CSR + key example:
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:3072 -out agent.key
openssl req -new -key agent.key -out agent.csr -subj "/CN=redwood-agent.ivy.poc/O=Ivy"

Natasha V: Minimal onboarding JSON (paste into Console):
{
  "customer":"Ivy",
  "vpc_id":"vpc-0abc1234",
  "subnets":["subnet-a","subnet-b"],
  "kms_key_arn":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:key/abcd-ef01",
  "agent_cert_pem":"-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----...",
  "key_transfer":"BYOK"
}

Amy S: Networking: agent needs outbound to api.redwood-inference.internal:443 and access to model URLs (S3/presigned). If strict egress, provide proxy or we'll deploy a relay.

CryptoBot: Onboard ticket created: https://internal.redwood/onboard/1990011222

Jordan L: Great. Amy will own customer comms; Natasha will drop a validation script link. I'll lock the 48h window once artifacts are received.
